sections.heading: The Trisomy
sections.body: A three-part musical odyssey exploring identity, memory, and legacy through hip-hop, poetry, and worldbuilding.

sections.heading: Obeah
sections.body: A contemporary spiritual mythology reclaiming Caribbean and African tradition through graphic novel form.

sections.heading: Tammy
sections.body: An immersive psychological experience about misinformation, identity, and the systems that shape what people believe.

/mythology.title: Lunacy Mythology | Lunacy Media
/mythology.description: Learn the story and core beliefs behind Lunacy Media: emotional truth, functional mythology, evolving identity, and creativity as an evolutionary force.
/mythology.ogDescription: The story of Lunacy Media, its core beliefs, and the mythology behind its creative practice.
/mythology.intro: Lunacy Media began as a long-term archive of evolution: a practice of building worlds that hold emotional truth, strategy, and collective possibility together.

sections.heading: Emotional truth has structural power
sections.body: The deepest truths about human experience can be encoded into systems, brands, and worlds.

sections.heading: Mythology is functional, not fiction
sections.body: Every identity and world operates through myths. Lunacy makes those frameworks visible and useful.

sections.heading: Identity is continuously constructed
sections.body: Creation is a way to reflect, revise, and intentionally reshape what comes next.

/contact.title: Initiate a Project | Lunacy Media
/contact.description: Contact Lunacy Media in Toronto, Canada to discuss mythology-led creative direction, original IP, identity systems, music, and immersive digital experiences.
/contact.ogDescription: Tell Lunacy Media what you are building, what feels unresolved, and what you want people to believe when they encounter your world.
/contact.eyebrow: THE FIRST PAGE OF THE MYTHOS BRIEF
